agent.name: Flag
agent.strategy: Bull flag: pole, quiet drift, breakout
agent.description: Well-formed bull flags across the universe: forming flags with their trigger and stop, and breakouts on volume with the trade attached.

context.label: Well-formed
context.value: flag vol <= 70% of pole, pullback <= 40%, 5-8 sessions

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 20% pole · 5-session flag · 30% pullback on 43% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: This flag is messier than textbook: the pullback barely qualifies at 30% retracement (clean flags typically hold 25-50%, so marginal), and forming on 43% volume is weak—strong flags consolidate on 50-75% lower volume, signaling conviction. The trigger at $82.90 would need to close above it with expansion back to pole volume to show real buyers; conversely, a break below $80.27 support or a third touch of the flag's top without breakout momentum would confirm distribution and kill it.

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 42% pole · 5-session flag · 24% pullback on 64% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: This flag looks messy—the pullback consumed 76% of the pole's gains (to $30.91), which is deeper than the textbook 20-33% range, suggesting weak follow-through on the initial move rather than healthy consolidation. A break above $33.30 with conviction and volume would be needed to validate it, but statistically forming flags are noise; a close below $30.91 would confirm the setup is already dead.

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 30% pole · 5-session flag · 25% pullback on 69% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: This flag is undermined by weak formation mechanics: the pole gained 30% but the flag's pullback only retraced 25% of it, leaving the stock still 26% above the pole's base—a shallow consolidation that suggests profit-taking rather than conviction to re-test the highs. A close above $61.92 (reclaiming the pole high) would confirm breakout potential, but a drop below $58.28 kills it; watch volume on any bounce—if it shrinks on a recovery toward $59.76, that's a red flag that sellers dominate.

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 23% pole · 5-session flag · 32% pullback on 59% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: This flag shows textbook structure but the 5-session consolidation on declining volume is a yellow flag—it suggests buyers aren't aggressively defending the range, which often precedes breakdown rather than breakout. Confirmation would require a decisive close above $45.03 on volume matching or exceeding the pole; any rejection below $43 or a close below $42.27 kills it and favors continuation lower. The burden of proof is on the bulls here, and statistically forming flags are noise more often than signal.

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 20% pole · 5-session flag · 39% pullback on 67% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: This flag setup is messier than ideal: the flag's low ($76.51) sits right at the stop level, leaving almost no margin for normal intraday noise, and the 67% volume during consolidation is relatively heavy, suggesting weak seller capitulation rather than a tight coil. Confirmation would require a decisive close above $77.96 on expanding volume with follow-through the next session; a break below $76.51 or a drift sideways past 5-7 sessions would likely signal the breakout lost conviction and the stock is consolidating at a lower equilibrium rather than gathering energy.

setup.title: Flag

opportunities.reasoning: This is a textbook bull flag setup on paper, but the forming stage is where most fail—the volume compression and retracement depth are sound, yet MAZE needs to decisively break $31.74 on expanding volume to prove continuation rather than just mean-reversion into resistance. If it rolls over below $30.54 or drifts sideways through the trigger without conviction, the flag collapses into a failed pattern that typically precedes further weakness, not the 32% upside the setup promises.

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 21% pole · 5-session flag · 37% pullback on 60% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning:
# GCT Bull Flag Assessment

This flag is **forming but messy**: the pole only gained 4.4% ($58.38 → $60.96) before rolling over, which is weak for a 20% bull flag claim, and the flag's 37% retracement is already deep—closer to a 50% mean reversion than a tight consolidation. Confirmation would require a clean break above $60.22 on volume expansion with the stock holding above $59.50, but a breakdown below $57.16 on any volume spike is more likely given that forming flags have shown negative edge historically and this one started from an already-exhausted micro-move.
